t: About – Virtual Environment Navigation Lab
s: The VENLab is a research facility designed to investigate human visual control of locomotion and the nature of cognitive maps during navigation. Virtual environments are presented to human participants via a head-mounted display, and their positions are recorded using an inside-out tracking system.
